paragraphs: At the beginning of Ketubot, chapter 13: they were Admon and Chanan ben Avishalom. In the Gemara there: Admon ben Gadai, Chanan the Egyptian and Chanan ben Avishalom; and according to Rabbi Natan, Nachum the Mede as well.[^1]

notes.text: The checked Mishnah names Admon and Chanan ben Avishalom. The Babylonian discussion gives the three-judge lists and says that Natan added Nachum the Mede but the Sages did not agree with him. Hyman’s abbreviated presentation does not establish consensus about that addition or identify every list as a single court.
